opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State, of Vermont. October 5, 1920. Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for plaintiff in error. Mr. Harry Burton Amey for plaintiff in error. Mr. J. TV. Redmond for defendant in error.
